name: REST controller
description: Adds a REST API controller extending Abstract_REST_Controller from rtcamp/wp-php-toolkit. Singleton by default (REST controllers wire hooks once per request).

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the controller class. Default 'Inc\Rest' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace (e.g. 'Acme\Blog\Rest') to override.
Directory for the controller file. Default 'includes/Rest' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-path to override.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Rest' matches the rtCamp skeleton; override alongside 'namespace' for non-default projects.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Rest'.
Resource slug (kebab-case, used as the REST route segment, e.g. 'images' for /wp-json/myplugin/v1/images).
PascalCase class name, derived from name.
REST API namespace (e.g. 'myplugin/v1'). Used as the first argument to register_rest_route().
Use rtcamp/wp-php-toolkit Singleton trait. Pass 'true' or 'false'. Default 'true' is appropriate for most REST controllers (one controller per resource, hook wiring happens once).

wiring.description: Instantiate the REST controller so it registers its rest_api_init hook. Insert in the plugin bootstrap method alongside other REST controllers. Singleton variants self-register on first get_instance(); multi-instance callers explicitly invoke register().
